summary: Iter97 Sprint C+D follow-on: ran full regression of 95 backend pytest guards across 6 files — ALL PASS (16 new iter97 + 15 iter96b sprint A/B + 23 iter96 corporate + 16 iter95 negotiation + 9 iter95b trainer-detail/AB + 16 iter95c batch). Additionally validated the new GET /api/messages/admin-contact endpoint live through the public ingress: 403 without auth (route registered, not 404), 200 with trainee token returning {conversationId, admin:{id, fullName, email, avatarUrl}}, and idempotent — two consecutive calls return the same conversationId 8773fb6a-c681-422c-b613-a7aa47aac488. Regression spot checks pass: /api/pricing/quote (GET) returns service_fee_cents=299 across tiers/modalities/durations (new/in_person/60/4000 and certified/virtual/90/8000 both verified); /api/corporate/sessions/quote returns subsidy=4000 cents on the seeded ACME enrollment for the test trainee.

minor.issue: Two users have isAdmin=true in this pod: trainer1@test.com (created 2026-03-03) and admin@rapidreps.com (created 2026-06-01). The endpoint sorts admins by createdAt ASC and returns the OLDER one, so callers get admin email=trainer1@test.com instead of admin@rapidreps.com that the review request implied. Endpoint logic is correct and idempotent; this is a seed-data ordering/intent concern. Consider tightening the query (e.g., {isAdmin:true, email:'admin@rapidreps.com'}) or deactivating the legacy trainer1 admin flag.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Constrain GET /api/messages/admin-contact admin lookup to a specific canonical admin (e.g., email=admin@rapidreps.com) OR demote/remove the duplicate isAdmin flag on trainer1@test.com — currently the endpoint resolves to the older trainer1 admin in this env.
critical_code_review_comments: messaging_routes.py admin-contact (lines 210-249): clean implementation — UUID4 conversation IDs match existing schema, idempotency via {participants: {$all: [user_id, admin_id]}} lookup before insert, 503 when no admin, 400 when admin is messaging self. Verified live: 2nd call returns same conversationId. Only nit is the ambiguous admin resolution noted above.
Endpoint correctly excludes mongo _id from response payload (admin.id is the stringified _id). No serialization leaks observed.
Auth gate works: 403 (not 404) when called without bearer token — confirms FastAPI dependency wiring is correct.
Regression coverage for the prior 79 tests is intact; no flakes observed across run (7.72s total, 95/95).
test_credentials: admin@rapidreps.com / admin123; test_trainer_iter25@test.com / Test123!; test_trainee_iter25@test.com / Test123! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all functional). NOTE: a second admin (trainer1@test.com) also exists with isAdmin=true and is older — see backend_issues.minor.
